after: For the cheap-let comparison, use a furniture adjustment already provided by the local rent index without adding it twice. Otherwise add a surcharge only if it can be established from the local market for furnished lets; if no market value can be determined, no surcharge is added. Never derive it from monthly furniture AfA or a standard investment return ([BFH, 6 February 2018, IX R 14/17, paras. 18 to 20](https://www.bundesfinanzhof.de/de/entscheidung/entscheidungen-online/detail/pdf/STRE201810105?type=1646225765)).
